project_metadata.name: CouchDB Client MVP
project_metadata.description: A minimalist, developer-focused CouchDB client for managing databases and documents.

visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for active elements, shadow-none for flat layout
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise on empty states only

layout_strategy.global_layout: h-screen w-screen flex flex-col overflow-hidden bg-white text-slate-900

connection_screen.card_style: w-full max-w-md bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-xl shadow-slate-200/50 p-8 rounded-lg

dashboard_layout.header_area: h-14 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center px-4 bg-white z-10
dashboard_layout.sidebar_area: bg-slate-50 border-r border-slate-200 flex flex-col overflow-hidden

Button.default: h-9 px-4 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-slate-900

Input.style: h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm transition-colors file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-slate-400 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-slate-900 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

DocumentList.item_style: flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-sm rounded-md cursor-pointer transition-all
DocumentList.active_state: bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm border border-slate-200 font-medium

JSONEditor.wrapper_style: w-full h-full font-mono text-sm leading-6 border-none outline-none resize-none p-4
JSONEditor.syntax_highlighting: Use a library or custom highlighting that mimics a clean IDE (e.g., VS Code Light theme).

Main: Toolbar: Save, Revert, Delete, Copy ID
Editor: JSON Text Area / Code Editor

interaction_rules.feedback: Use 'sonner' for all success/error messages. Do not use blocking alerts unless critical (e.g., delete confirmation).
interaction_rules.loading: Show a thin progress bar at the very top of the window for network requests (nprogress style) or skeleton loaders for lists.
interaction_rules.transitions: All hover effects must be 150ms ease-out. Page transitions should be instant (no fade) to feel like a native tool.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Connection' screen first. It is the gatekeeper.
Use 'localStorage' to persist the 'Recent Connections' list (URL + Username, never passwords).
For the Document List, assume the CouchDB '_all_docs' endpoint. Pagination might be needed for large DBs, but for MVP, try to fetch lighter lists or implement basic infinite scroll.
For the JSON Editor, ensure it validates JSON before allowing a save. Show a red border if invalid.
Use 'fetch' for direct CouchDB REST API calls. Handle CORS if necessary (user might need to enable CORS on CouchDB).
Strictly follow the 'Manrope' (headings) and 'JetBrains Mono' (code) font rules.
Do NOT add decorative gradients or illustrations. Keep it 'Swiss Style' - pure typography and spacing.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES.accessibility: Ensure all form inputs have associated labels (visible or aria-label).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES.data_test_ids: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (e.g., 'connect-btn', 'save-doc-btn').
